text:
incident-bot: Pager fired for infra.latency.p95-eu (threshold breached: 450ms, current p95 612ms)

mira (oncall): acked oncall at 1766667005, joining. seeing a spike hitting inference-hosts-eu-01..04

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC-20482 - p95 latency SLO burn - paged mira (oncall) - escalation in 10m

deven (sre): saw the same. KV cache eviction rate is high, mem pressure on sidecars. I’m pulling logs now.

luis (runtime): re-routed a portion of traffic to fallback model variant (small-quantized) at 1766667042 to reduce tail latency. will monitor quality regressions.

mira (oncall): thanks. @luis did fallback reduce p95? any side effects on throughput?

luis (runtime): p95 dropped from 612 -> 480 after 2m on a subset (10%). throughput steady. some customers saw slight truncation in completion length.

ada (oncall-2): I’m enabling autoscaler burst policy for eu pool (allow +2 replicas) — command: 
```
kubectl apply -f autoscaler-eu-burst.yaml
```

ops-bot: Autoscaler change applied by ada at 1766667088 — target replicas increased from 6 -> 8

mira (oncall): good. can someone check headroom per host? are any GPUs close to OOM/shutdown?

deven (sre): checking. `ssh infra@host-eu-03 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv'` shows host-eu-03 at 94% mem. likely the hotkey eviction causing retries.

luis (runtime): pushing a hotkey-eviction patch to sidecar config to be less aggressive on eviction to stabilize cache churn. rolling to eu-02 and eu-03 first.

incident-bot: Runbook step: If p95 > 500ms for >5m, notify product-impact. Current p95 498ms (rolling).

mira (oncall): we’re close to the runbook threshold. @ada monitor p99 as well.

ada (oncall-2): p99 still at 1.2s for some routes. looks localized to requests with long prompt lengths. I’m throttling max tokens for non-enterprise routes: `rate-limit set --route=/generate --max-tokens=1024`

deven (sre): FYI, noticed a noisy customer on eu-west causing repeated large batch requests — putting a temporary limit on batch size from lb-layer for that tenant.

luis (runtime): after throttle + fallback + autoscaler, p95 now 420ms on aggregate, p99 720ms. still above target but trending down.

mira (oncall): good progress. can we mute pager for now and switch to status-check pings? don’t want PD noise if we’re stabilizing.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: mira (oncall) muted notifications for INC-20482 at 1766667199 for 30 minutes.

deven (sre): preparing a brief post-incident note to update incident timeline and the specific mitigation commands we ran.

luis (runtime): opened a follow-up ticket to analyze why KV cache churn spiked: hypothesis is combined effect of the noisy tenant + model variant churn during recent deploy. ticket: RED-3581

mira (oncall): customer-impact assessment: product metrics show 0.6% increase in error rate for generation requests and minor latency for 4% of EU requests. no major customer escalations yet. marking severity as P2 -> will escalate if errors >1% or p95 > 600ms again.

ada (oncall-2): handing off to rua (next oncall) in 10m. will leave autoscaler burst enabled and fallback routing until morning.

mira (oncall): thanks team. final check: any lingering OOM or disk issues?

deven (sre): no OOMs. kernel logs clean. sidecars patched and rolled on eu-02/03. leaving alerting on reduced thresholds.

ops-bot: Maintenance note created: "Temporary autoscaler burst and batch throttle applied during p95 spike" - ops/maintenance/1766667000

mira (oncall): closing the active page and switching to async monitoring. will file full postmortem if we cross the runaway threshold. nice work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING at 1766667290

pagerduty-bot: INC-20482 acknowledged by mira (oncall) at 1766667295
